Mastery is a key source of engagement, yet designing for it requires extensive human play and tuning. items.summary: Videos reveal how the world changes, but rarely the actions that cause those changes. Latent action learning recovers such supervision from visual transitions, yet often learns the underlying dynamics largely from scratch. We ask whether a pretrained video generator can instead provide the prior for...
items.summary_cn: 视频揭示了世界是如何变化的，但很少揭示导致这些变化的行动。潜在动作学习从视觉过渡中恢复这种监督，但通常是从头开始学习潜在的动态。我们想知道，预训练的视频生成器是否可以替代地为...
